caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric with a central floral design and a decorative geometric border. The background of the fabric is a muted, light brown or tan color. The border consists of a repeating Greek key or meander pattern in black, forming a solid frame around the central area. In the center, there is a cluster of flowers with large, overlapping petals. One prominent flower is red with white and black accents, another is primarily white or pale-colored, and there are smaller purple and yellow flowers surrounding them. The leaves are in various shades of green, positioned around the flowers. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the floral arrangement placed centrally inside the bordered square. The edges of the fabric are slightly frayed, revealing the fabric's weave and texture.
title: Piece of Cross-Stitch
